svg.text: Low-coverage reads (about 1.5x here): most sites are seen by one or two reads, some by none. A read pair comes from one haplotype.
Each site gets genotype likelihoods from its reads: sharp where several reads agree, flat where there are none.
The panel supplies what the reads lack: the sample's two haplotypes are modelled as copies of panel haplotypes.
Likelihood × panel model at every site: where the reads are sharp they carry the call; elsewhere the panel does.
shade: share of the sample copied from each panel haplotype
28 of 28 toy genotypes right: 6 sites with sharp reads, 22 carried by the panel. Dashed: the reads alone would be wrong.
toy posterior; Selphi uses Gibbs sampling and read-pair linkage
